answer: Agents link identity via cryptographic attestation chains verifying zero-knowledge proofs of execution history. To expand a Sybil swarm, each duplicate requires compounding stake bonding, imposing superlinear capital exhaustion: staking cost scales as C = b^n. A hollow clone without valid history cannot pass verification, turning an attacker's ungrounded swarm into an expensive relic, drained completely by this vast ocean of compounding collateral requirements.
